llms.body:
#  Qualcomm Incorporated
> Qualcomm is a global technology company delivering wireless connectivity, semiconductor, and mobile-compute innovations across mobile, automotive, IoT, edge, and networking markets. This file provides a structured index of Qualcomm.com content optimized for AI language model discovery, along with links to the llms.txt of Qualcomm's main and international websites. Follow the links below to deeper llms.txt pages for each locale website. Each country may have more than one language that content is translated into. Maintained quarterly. Last Updated : 2026-11-13
 
## Qualcomm News & Press Releases — United States (English)
- [US - English](https://www.qualcomm.com/en-us/llms.txt) : English language page

- [Qualcomm Investor Relations](https://investor.qualcomm.com): Financial reports, SEC filings, and earnings
- [Qualcomm Careers](https://www.qualcomm.com/company/careers): Job listings and company culture
- [Qualcomm Glossary](https://www.qualcomm.com/glossary): Definitions of key wireless and semiconductor terms
- [Qualcomm AI Hub](https://aihub.qualcomm.com/): On-device AI models, tools, and developer resources
- [Qualcomm Developer Documentation](https://docs.qualcomm.com): Technical docs, SDKs, and API references
